description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_SafeScripting which extends HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule. It implements a 'SafeScripting' module for HTMLPurifier to restrict inline JavaScript and manage safe external script inclusion by whitelisting URLs and enforcing attribute transformations.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_SafeScripting
classes.description: A class that adds security measures for scripting in HTML, preventing inline scripts and validating script sources.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the safe scripting module by adding a 'script' element with specific attribute restrictions and transformations based on configuration.
